goal: Prevent block data needed for rescans or indexing from being pruned when wallets or external tools disconnect
Let users and external software manually set prune locks via RPC and startup options
reviewability: Only minor unaddressed suggestions remain on lock removal handling and prefix naming
agreement: Strong support for enabling external indexers and wallets on pruned nodes (achow101, stickies-v, optout21)
Verified by testing electrs indexing and prune lock behavior on signet (optout21, GEREMIAA)
Nonblocking suggestion to reject unexpected height argument on lock removal (GEREMIAA)
Suggestion to replace internal string prefix with an enum or flag (optout21)

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because it adds RPCs that let external tools and wallets safely run against pruned nodes
Protects required blocks from deletion during wallet rescans or indexer restarts
